info.name: Ignition Gateway REST access-control storage API

params.name: folderPath
params.description: (Required) The path to the temporary folder. This folder path is relative to the EAM system temp folder.

items.docs: Deletes the folder containing the previously uploaded files for an EAM task

params.name: filePath
params.description: (Required) The file path to the temporary .modl file

items.docs: Retrieves module certificate information from an uploaded .modl file

params.name: filePath
params.description: (Required) The file path to the temporary certificate file extracted from the .modl file

items.docs: Adds a resource to the controller indicating that the user has accepted a module certificate.

params.name: filePath
params.description: (Required) The file path to the temporary license.html file extracted from the .modl file

items.docs: Retrieves a module EULA from an uploaded .modl file. The EULA is returned as HTML.

params.name: filePath
params.description: (Required) The file path to the temporary license.html file extracted from the .modl file

params.name: moduleId
params.description: (Required) The module id of the .modl file

items.docs: Adds a resource to the controller indicating that the user has accepted a module EULA.
Uploads a .gwbk for temporary storage on the controller. The returned gwbk path is relative to the EAM system temp folder.

params.name: filename
params.description: (Required) Used as the filename when the .modl is uploaded to the gateway's file system. The file is stored in a temporary folder.

items.docs: Uploads a .modl file for temporary storage on the controller. The returned modlFile path is relative to the EAM system temp folder.

params.name: filePath
params.description: (Required) The file path of the archived module file, as returned from the archived-modules endpoint. The file is stored in a temporary folder.

items.docs: Adds an archived module file to temporary storage on the controller. The returned modlFile path is relative to the EAM system temp folder.
Upload an Ignition upgrade.zip for temporary storage on the controller. The returned filePath holds the path to the upgrade.zip and is relative to the EAM system temp folder.

params.name: serverids
params.description: (Required) A comma-separated list of encoded ServerIds

items.docs: Retrieves a list of gateway backups for the specified agents. Returned file paths are relative to the EAM archive folder.
Retrieves a list of modules archived on the EAM controller. Returned module file paths are relative to the EAM archive folder.
